component.name: paintnotnet
component.summary: Image and photo editor modelled on paint.net

description.p: A modern paint.net for Linux: layers with blend modes, selections with live feathering, painting and shape tools, adjustments and effects, and paint.net's keyboard shortcuts.

ul.li: Opens and saves paint.net .pdn and OpenRaster files with their layers
PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF and TGA
Remove Background and Select Subject with a local AI model
Drawn on the GPU, with large photos staying responsive
